news.headline: MAK Capital Discloses 7.8% Stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One, and Michael A. Kaufman raised their passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro to 2,375,861 shares (7.8% of shares outstanding) in an amended Schedule 13G filed August 12, 2026, up from a previously disclosed 6.3% stake. The increase came in the days after the post-earnings selloff, signaling continued institutional accumulation.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Q2 2026 Earnings Call: FDA Reversals Reopen Door for Partner BLA Filings
news.summary: On the Q2 call, ClearPoint's CEO said the FDA has recently reversed guidance on a number of rare-disease decisions, reopening the door for several of the company's 60-plus biopharma partners to submit BLAs later in 2026, with potential commercial approvals for cell and gene therapies delivered via ClearPoint's platform as early as 2027.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro (CLPT) Stock Falls on Q2 2026 Earnings
news.summary: Shares of ClearPoint Neuro fell sharply after the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, with analysts Lake Street and Stifel trimming their price targets to $25 (from $30) and $22 (from $25) respectively. The stock closed well below its 52-week high of $30.10 as investors weighed rising cash burn against the company's long-term growth narrative.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Aug 2026 slides: $500m revenue target amid Q2 miss
news.summary: Alongside its Q2 report, ClearPoint Neuro unveiled a five-pillar strategy targeting $500 million in annual revenue, combining neurosurgery navigation, CRO/preclinical services, its IRRAS neurocritical-care business, and eventual commercial cell and gene therapy delivery royalties. Much of the additional upside depends on biopharma partners reaching commercial drug launches starting in 2027.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro posted Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9 million, up 18% year-over-year but about $1.8 million below consensus, with neurosurgery navigation and therapy revenue up 62% while biologics and drug delivery revenue declined 15% on fewer biopharma trial initiations. The company cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48-52 million, and cash fell to $29.4 million from $45.9 million at the start of the year as operating expenses rose 51% on the IRRAS integration.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: The FDA granted RMAT designation to Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the Phase 1/2a ASPIRO trial. The designation enables more frequent FDA interaction and a potential accelerated approval path, validating ClearPoint's delivery-platform role with a key cell-therapy partner.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease in Q3 2026 after the FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data can support accelerated approval; ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula/navigation platform is used for delivery in the program.

catalysts.label: ClearPoint Prism Neuro Laser Therapy System EU CE Mark decision
catalysts.detail: Partner Clinical Laserthermia Systems submitted CE-marking applications covering both 1.5T and 3.0T MRI compatibility for the ClearPoint Prism Neuro Laser Therapy System; a decision is expected in the second half of 2026, which would open the European market for MRI-guided laser ablation.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro is expected to report Q3 2026 results in early November, based on its prior-year reporting cadence, with investors watching whether the cut $48-52M full-year guidance holds and whether cash burn stabilizes.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene therapy launches
catalysts.detail: Management says more than 60 biopharma partner programs use its delivery platform, several under FDA expedited review after the agency reversed course on multiple rare-disease gene therapy decisions in mid-2026; ClearPoint believes additional cell and gene therapies could reach commercial launch by the end of 2027, generating device and royalty revenue.

catalysts.label: $500M five-pillar revenue roadmap / robotics & focused ultrasound platforms
catalysts.detail: Management's long-term plan layers commercial cell/gene therapy delivery royalties on top of existing device, CRO, and neurocritical-care revenue, alongside continued development of its robotic surgical platform, Harmony 1.0 software, and the 10-year focused ultrasound drug-delivery partnership with Sungkyunkwan University's SONOCARE Lab in South Korea.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's stock has stayed under pressure since its August 3, 2026 Q2 report showed 18% revenue growth to $10.9 million but missed Wall Street estimates, prompting a cut to full-year 2026 guidance ($48-52M), price-target reductions from Lake Street and Stifel, and a cash balance down to $29.4 million amid rising IRRAS-integration opex. Management is leaning on a longer-term '$500 million' five-pillar strategy spanning navigation devices, CRO/preclinical services, neurocritical care, and eventual commercial cell/gene therapy delivery royalties, buoyed by the FDA's mid-2026 reversal on several rare-disease gene therapy decisions that is reopening BLA paths for partners including uniQure (Q3 2026 BLA target) and Aspen Neuroscience (July 2026 RMAT designation). Institutional investor MAK Capital raised its stake to 7.8% in mid-August even as near-term dilution and execution risk keep the stock volatile.
